reviews.comment: Homework in this class is insane, theres one assignment he gives each semester that literally takes 20 hours for about .7% of your final grade. This class demands a lot of time and the way grades are weighted does not corroborate this.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr Valasek is an amazing prof. He is very passionate about Aerospace and does his best to pass that on to the students. His lectures are always interesting and the workload is manageable. Quizzes are either free or quite difficult. Sometimes questions from previous blocks appear unexpectedly. Other than that, Dr Valasek is amazing, highly recommend

Professor Valasek is extremely knowledgeable on AERO but this class had a disconnect between the lectures and assignments due to his lecture style. The quizzes were insanely hard and were never covered in lectures, there was a ton of work outside of class with experimental points, and a huge amount of reading before lectures.

Although this class is tough and you will want to hurt yourself at times, I would absolutely recommend Valasek if you're passionate about AERO. He is very knowledgeable and his lectures are far from boring. You will have to read a lot for (at least) weekly assessments. You will get to do some cool things for this as well like flight sim.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor is very knowledgeable about the subject (s)he teaches. Unfortunately, I never really understood whenever (s)he compared airplanes to rats. I don't understand how the two are related, but it was always awe-inspiring to see he(r) go off on those explanations. The quizzes were hard for me, as someone with one arm, but you should be fine
